sources.title: Expression of Genes Encoding Multi-Transmembrane Proteins in Specific Primate Taste Cell Populations
sources.source_location: Human taste-bud results and Figure 10D; Methods: human tissue collection and PCR
sources.finding: CALHM3 RNA was measured by semi-quantitative PCR in laser-captured human circumvallate taste buds, with no detectable or reduced expression in surrounding lingual epithelium.
sources.limitations: Human data are RNA from a microdissected compartment. Cell-subtype in situ experiments elsewhere in this paper used macaques. This is not human protein detection or a therapeutic depletion experiment.
sources.retention_reason: Corrects the earlier mouse-only assessment of CALHM3 and supplies human normal-compartment counterevidence. It is not a CTA nomination.

sources.title: Comparison of tear protein levels in breast cancer patients and healthy controls using a de novo proteomic approach
sources.source_location: Table II; pooled sampling and MALDI identification methods; Table III does not quantify TRIM75
sources.finding: Table II lists TRI75_HUMAN (TRIM75) among tear-fluid proteins in a study of 25 breast-cancer patients and 25 healthy women.
sources.limitations: One pooled tear sample per clinical group. Table II merges identifications and does not assign TRIM75 to a pool or supply its peptide sequences. Tear-fluid detection does not localize the producing tissue or demonstrate a tumor origin.
sources.retention_reason: Hold normal-restriction clearance until the contributing pool and peptide specificity are resolved. The merged table establishes neither a healthy-control positive nor cancer-specific protein.

sources.title: Histone demethylase KDM4A overexpression improved the efficiency of corrected human tripronuclear zygote development
sources.source_location: Table I Ubtfl1 primers; Figure 5; NCBI XM_021185540.2 and exact forward/reverse-complement cDNA comparisons
sources.finding: The Ubtfl1 row in Table I cites XM_021185540.2, a Mus caroli Sod1 transcript. Its two primer sequences do not match selected human UBTFL1 ENST00000530464.2 and both match mouse Sod1 ENSMUST00000023707.10.
sources.limitations: This finding rejects attribution of this specific assay. It does not reject the other experiments in the paper or establish normal UBTFL1 expression. Mouse Hmgpi and human UBTFL2/3 results cannot be substituted for this copy.
sources.retention_reason: Do not count this assay as exact-human UBTFL1 support. Independent human embryo RNA and the qualifying coding reference retain their own evidence status.

sources.title: Identification of potential crucial genes associated with the pathogenesis and prognosis of liver hepatocellular carcinoma
sources.source_location: Supplementary Table S3, PDF page 101; differential-expression table header on page 1
sources.finding: Supplementary Table S3 includes TMEM269 as upregulated in TCGA LIHC, log2 fold change 1.257588672, logCPM -3.45323963 and FDR 1.69e-6.
sources.limitations: The supplementary RNA comparison is a reanalysis of TCGA, not an independent tumor cohort. Low average RNA expression and a differential-expression statistic do not establish an accessible membrane protein.
sources.retention_reason: Add exact-symbol tumor RNA context. This paper does not nominate a CTA or demonstrate protein localization, antigen presentation or normal-tissue restriction.

sources.title: CDCA8, targeted by MYBL2, promotes malignant progression and olaparib insensitivity in ovarian cancer
sources.source_location: Figure 4 and Table S2; combined publisher PDF page 45 (supplement page 18)
sources.finding: Table S2 lists SSU72P7, the previous symbol of SSU72L1, with log2 fold change 5.779251523 (54.91968795-fold) and adjusted P 9.14e-69 after CDCA8 knockdown.
sources.limitations: The table reports a gene-level RNA result, not unique-read or peptide validation. SSU72 phosphatase experiments are not transferable to SSU72L1 or to SSU72L2-5.
sources.retention_reason: Add exact-copy-symbol cancer-cell RNA context, retaining the old symbol. A perturbation response does not establish baseline tumor prevalence, protein production or CTA identity.

memberships.scope: Exact human gene, normal circumvallate taste-bud RNA; Figure 10D
memberships.recommendation: Review hold: human normal taste-bud RNA plus the established mouse taste-channel function warrant a normal-compartment review before target clearance. Do not call this proven human protein or infer an injury outcome.
